notes.title: New Fighting Fantasy Classics 25% OFF!
notes.content:
TRIAL OF CHAMPIONS has arrived! The sequel to [i]Deathtrap Dungeon[/i] joins a stellar roster of fantasy adventures in [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i] - the ultimate library of text-based role playing games. And to celebrate, it's 25% OFF! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/897190/Trial_of_Champions/]Check it out here.[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33039573/a6d64fdadb1fcc1c90a0c798cac92a41bbce8ed9.png[/img]

[i]Trial of Champions[/i] sees you delve into the dread corridors of Baron Sukumvit’s terrible challenge for a second stab at glory. But beware! The Trial will be even more devilishly difficult this time as you begin your adventure having been captured and sold into slavery! With nothing to prepare you for this arduous adventure but your SKILL, LUCK and STAMINA, you must explore the deadly labyrinth beneath Fang. For only by triumphing in the Trial can you win back your freedom from Baron Sukumvit’s evil brother – Lord Carnuss.

Will it be enough?!

Find out for yourself and pick up this classic title [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/897190/Trial_of_Champions/]while it's just 2.99 USD.[/url]

Also joining the [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i] shelf is another old favourite – Steve Jackson’s [i]House of Hell[/i]. We’ve remastered this title for the [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i] library, so it can take its rightful place amongst your collection. It is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/897180/House_of_Hell_Fighting_Fantasy_Classics/]also 25% OFF[/url] for a limited time. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33039573/2e02525bf6cbcfc88d0dbeb0a2e7103be93af2fc.png[/img]

[i]House of Hell’s[/i] addition to the library comes with a handful of updates including:
[list]
[*] Adventure Sheet now includes 'Fear' mechanic. 
[*] Knowledge Sheet to track the clues you discover.
[*] Tim Sell’s original artwork, as well as coloured editions of each piece.
[*] [i]Haunted Hallways[/i] ambient track added.
[*] Achievements added for both [i]Trial of Champions[/i] and [i]House of Hell[/i].
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33039573/aaf8f602b920bdc08fb7f9df81eeeee1bd82499c.png[/img]

Whether you're heading into the depths of the labyrinth beneath the city of Fang, or braving the haunted halls of the House of Drumer, may LUCK be with you and your STAMINA never fail!

notes.title: Fighting Fantasy Classics are coming!
notes.content:
As part of our $40k Stretch Goal for [i]The Warlock of Firetop Mountain[/i] Kickstarter we promised a classic version of TWOFM using our older [i]Gamebook Adventures Engine[/i]. It’s taken a while but we can now proudly announce that it will be available in 2018. Not only that but we have big plans for Fighting Fantasy and will be adapting a number of your old favourites in that old engine too!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25736678/47ef17233bdf27263ce49bdc7f6b42ee34ba2619.jpg[/img]

Press Release: Wednesday 13th December

[h1]New Digital Collection of Classic Fighting Fantasy Gamebooks in the Works [/h1]

Tin Man Games are currently developing [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i], a digital library app for iOS, Android, PC and Mac, that will collect many of the gamebooks from the ever-popular [i]Fighting Fantasy[/i] series. The original adventures, written and presented by Ian Livingstone and Steve Jackson, are being converted to a digital gamebook format. Combat and skill rolls will be resolved by rolling realistic 3D dice, and the famous Adventure sheet, normally found at the front of the books, functions in the game via an autofill system.

The library will debut early 2018 and will feature [i]Fighting Fantasy[/i] titles previously released by Tin Man Games, along with new adaptations previously unseen in Tin Man’s gamebook engine. Favourites such as [i]The Warlock of Firetop Mountain, The Citadel of Chaos[/i], and [i]City of Thieves[/i] will join [i]Bloodbones, Caverns of the Snow Witch, Island of the Lizard King and The Forest of Doom[/i].

Neil Rennison, Creative Director for Tin Man Games, said: “We’ve been one of the digital custodians of the [i]Fighting Fantasy[/i] license for a number of years now and feel that it’s about time that the original fans, as well as newcomers, are able to play the classics on their smartphones and tablets. We’ve updated our old gamebook engine and plan to release a large number of the gamebooks that players will be able to purchase within the one app.”

New releases will be staggered across the next 18 months and will include [i]Deathtrap Dungeon, Sword of the Samurai[/i] and [i]Creature of Havoc[/i] amongst many others. Where possible Tin Man Games will use the original artwork from the gamebooks as well as adding new illustrations to bring the interactive adventures to life.

Neil continued: “We also have plans to include lots of extras over time, including music options, new dice designs and page skins. There are a lot of titles in the original collection that have never been re-published, so it’s a very exciting time for [i]Fighting Fantasy[/i] fans!”

[i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i] will be available to download in February 2018 for iOS and Android. It will also be available on PC and Mac via Steam a few months later.
